main_body: Open treasure chest brimming with a gold and gem heap, with a small gold pile at the lower right
top_band: Gold heap with gems, rows 3-8 at x=17 (light gold L~138-191, with a darker row 6). It sits above the front face, which starts at row 9 (L~101).
evidence: The column at x=17 meets a gold heap with gems on rows 3-8, then a step of about 37 L (138 to 101) to the wooden front face on rows 9-15. The heap rises above the chest rim and reads as a horizontal contents surface seen from above, about 6 rows tall, which is enough for a 3/4 view. The front shows planks, dark iron straps and a lock plate. It is only partly inset, but the heap, rim and front face are clearly separate. No receding side face is drawn. The pile at the right is a small extra detail.

style.evidence: The candidate has 27 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references, and 0% flat-fill coverage. Its dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is tinted dark brown. The wood has several tones, and the gold has highlights, shadow and gem accents in red, teal and purple. It looks as rich as the references and not like a sticker.
